items.title: Paper Archive
items.summary: A reading tracker for 6,185 papers on monopoly and market power. Four buttons per paper (printed, read, notes, researched), and every click is saved back to the repository as a commit.

items.title: Deeper Stash
items.summary: Bite-sized ideas from books, articles and podcasts in a swipeable feed, with stashes, guided journeys, quizzes and a spaced daily review so they stick.

items.title: North Star Atlas
items.summary: The interactive side of the Minnesota Climate Project: map county patterns, compare a county with the state, and see the regression results as charts.

items.title: TELLER
items.summary: A money-and-banking tutor that lives in a retro terminal. Pick a machine, from a Commodore 64 to MS-DOS, set the pace and the difficulty, and work through the chapter at the prompt.

items.title: REFEREE
items.summary: A retro-terminal tutor for 54 classic papers on competition, monopoly and cost theory, 1886 to 1942. Six volumes with typed lessons, animated diagrams, boss fights, flashcards and a who-said-it game.

items.title: Competition & Cost Study Hub
items.summary: Exam prep for 54 classic papers on competition, monopoly and cost theory: a timeline map, a one-page brief for each paper, the debates step by step, a practice exam with answers and 465 flashcards.

items.title: Recall
items.summary: An offline flashcard studio for Windows that pairs Quizlet-style study modes and games with Anki-style spaced repetition (SM-2 or FSRS).

items.title: Money & Banking
items.summary: A whole money-and-banking course in 23 chapters, from the financial system and interest rates to banks, central banks and monetary policy.

items.title: Math Stats
items.summary: Sampling distributions, estimation, hypothesis tests, linear models, ANOVA, nonparametrics and Bayesian methods, with every chapter problem turned into a quiz.

items.title: Bonds & Loans
items.summary: Bond and loan maths in four steps: learn, flashcards, practice, test yourself. Fill-in-the-blanks, a matching game and a formula sheet come with it.
